text: Your alarm rings you stretch you grow just enough to reach the top shelf You shrink back down Lily loses her earring.
You walk underneath and find it You hand it to her.
You grow back your mom calls from the kitchen Noah breakfast now and your tea is still hot Your name is Noah.
You can change your size Anytime, but there is a rule your body stays yours.
Your muscles do not grow with you.
Your bones do not get tougher Grow 10 times taller and you are 10 times weaker for your weight Shrink 10 times smaller and a raindrop hits like a stone.
So what if you could change your size?
